Apple has updated the Apple Store app's privacy policy to include terms regarding an upcoming virtual shopping assistant. Details are as follows.

Apple is expanding the use of AI across its retail operations.

According to a discovery by MacRumors, a new section titled "Virtual Shopping Assistant" has been added to the Apple Store app and its privacy page, with the following content:

In other words, the Apple Store app may soon feature a chatbot that uses user data to provide personalised responses, helping users make purchasing decisions.

Apple states that before sharing conversation content with unnamed partners who also provide responses for the chatbot, it will first remove identifying information. This approach suggests that at least part of the experience will be supported by third-party models provided by external companies.

Chat records will be retained within the app for users to review at any time, while Apple will also store them for business analytics. Users can independently choose whether to allow their conversations to be used to improve the Virtual Shopping Assistant through a new "Chat Improvements" setting.

The wording of Apple's privacy policy indicates that this virtual assistant will initially be available in only a small number of countries and regions, most likely launching first in English-speaking markets before gradually expanding to more languages and regions.

This news comes several months after Apple added an AI chatbot to its "Sales Coach" app. That app provides sales and technical resources for the company's retail partners. Users can access the chatbot through the "Ask" tab, where the bot answers questions based on Apple's official training materials and documents.

Additionally, this news follows a Bloomberg report that Apple is testing a system called "Live Notes" at select retail stores. The system uses AI to record, transcribe, and summarise Genius Bar service sessions, allowing employees to focus on assisting customers without having to take notes while handling other tasks.
